messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 5xx rate on prod-gateway (us-west-2). Error spike started ~10:12 UTC. Alert: gateway_5xx_rate > 4% for 5m. Traces failing to show request ids. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/gateway-overview
oncall_jun: on it. grabbing logs and timeline. any deploys in last 30m?
sam_engr: I pushed a config bump to ingress-controller ~10:05 for timeout tuning but no image change. pushing context: we toggled `proxy.buffering=false` for long-polls.
kevin_sre: seeing 502/504s from edge -> backend timeouts. but the tracer headers (x-request-id / x-trace-id) are not present in many access logs — traces look sparse. suspecting header strip at our LB or envoy change.
elaine_prod: CS reporting 3 customers with failed inference API requests and retries. ETA impact: degraded for some realtime routes (chat generation).
maria_obs: in metrics: error rate peaked at 12% at 10:14. latency also increased. sampling rate for spans dropped to near zero across the gateway tier. logs pulled from pods show no request-id env substitution.
oncall_jun: ok assigning. kevin, can you run log grep + quick update to enable request-id propagation logging? if we can't get traces, we need stopgap instrumentation.
kevin_sre: doing quick patch: plan to enable access logs on nginx sidecar and inject X-Request-Id header if missing. will patch daemonset to add `more_set_headers "X-Request-Id: $request_id"` and set log format to include that. command I will run:
```
kubectl patch daemonset ingress-nginx -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"nginx","env":[{"name":"FORCE_REQUEST_ID","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```
kevin_sre: also increase trace sampling locally to 100% for 15m on gateway to capture any available spans.
sam_engr: note: we already route heavy traffic to v2 route; maybe fallback to v1 if v2 backend is failing. can we /should we route 10% to stable?
oncall_jun: do an immediate 10% canary to stable for affected route. Maria, can you set routing in traffic-router?
maria_obs: setting canary: route `chat.generate` 10% -> model-stable v1. command: `trafficctl split set chat.generate --to model-stable:v1=10 --to model-v2=90`
maria_obs: done. monitoring delta on error rate.
kevin_sre: access log patch applied. I see X-Request-Id injected for new requests. pushing a quick Fluentd config to index these lines into logs with request id.
kevin_sre: logs show majority of 5xx have upstream `504 gateway_timeout` with backend connection reset. backend pool showing high queue wait.
elaine_prod: CS: prepare a short customer-impact blurb: "We are aware of intermittent service errors affecting realtime inference; a partial traffic reroute and live mitigation are in progress. More updates in 30m."
cs_lead: please include affected endpoints and approximate % impacted.
oncall_jun: current: ~8% error rate across chat.generate overall, but for a subset of customers hitting v2 route it's ~25%. time window 10:12-10:25 UTC.
kevin_sre: quick mitigation options being evaluated: 1) increase backend pool size (scale up nodes) 2) apply short-lived connection timeout rollback 3) route small traffic to stable (done) 4) temporary retry on client side with jitter.
sam_engr: rolling back proxy.buffering toggle to previous commit might reduce resets. I'll open a revert PR and queue a hotpatch.
maria_obs: note: APM traces are still missing for older requests due to header strip at LB. we need to rule out the L4 LB rewrite rules. ops to check LB config now.
kevin_sre: LB team confirmed no config changes, but we found an Envoy filter added yesterday that rewrites `traceparent` when header size > 1k. that might drop header. I'll disable that filter for gateway cluster temporarily.
oncall_jun: do it and watch for traces.
kevin_sre: disabled envoy filter. trace headers start appearing in ingress logs at 10:32 UTC. sampling now shows spans inside services.
maria_obs: good — traces returning. correlated a sample request: trace shows backend queue hit and then timeout on model-worker pod (OOM kill seen around 10:10).
elaine_prod: OOMs on model-worker could explain connection resets. any correlation with autoscaler activity?
sam_engr: autoscaler didn't scale due to target CPU misconfig. I'll bump desired replicas from 3 -> 6 as a short-term stopgap.
kevin_sre: replicas bumped. also temporarily set `model-worker` memory limit +20% to reduce OOMs until we get a better sizing.
kevin_sre: monitor: error rate trending down from 12% to 4% at 10:45. still above baseline but improving.
oncall_jun: action items: - (kevin) keep access logging + trace sampling for 30m - (sam) PR + hotpatch revert if rollout proves problematic - (maria) continue canary split and rollback plan - (elaine) customer comms draft and notify top 10 customers.
cs_lead: sending customer note now. include link to status page and expected time to full recovery.
kevin_sre: follow-up: we still lack long-term instrumentation for request-id at LB level. propose a short RFC and dedicated fix: ensure all LB -> envoy -> ingress chain preserves trace headers and add automatic header injection at LB if absent.
sam_engr: agreed. we'll track as follow-up ticket. for now mitigation stabilized. will keep thread open until 2 consecutive 15m windows at baseline. :white_check_mark:
oncall_jun: marking incident as mitigated for now; keeping monitoring for recurrence. will update postmortem if we confirm root cause components (envoy filter + autoscaler misconfig + memory sizing).
incident-bot: Incident: mitigated state recorded at 10:50 UTC. Pager closed but follow-up required: link to incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood.example/INC-2026-1142
